643-2493-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-2493-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2645-3664-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Lotus Field.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Lotus Field's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

719-2981-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-2981-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

2653-2893-6664-7941.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Syndicate Liquidators trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2187-3115-3557.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2267-3240-5231-6462.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2921-4871-5220-6594.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2921-4871-5220-6594.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2292-2781-6767.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1486-1753-5929-7014.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat.
1486-1753-5929-7014.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

3518-4195-4574-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3518-4195-4574-6650.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1168-1651-2499-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-2499-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-2499-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

618-1734-6798.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3073-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

800-4116-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with different powers.
800-4116-5457.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

2511-3821-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2511-3821-5140.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat.

527-5140-5256.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-5140-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-5140-5256.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Selvala, causing target player to mill cards equal to Selvala's power.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-5140-5256.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1437-6017.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-6017.description:
Cast Maulfist Revolutionary by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Maulfist Revolutionary spell three times.
Resolve the first Maulfist Revolutionary spell.
When the Maulfist Revolutionary token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-6017.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Maulfist Revolutionary spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

394-4798-5435-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-4798-5435-5686.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat.

997-5663--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-5663--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1913-3134-4050-4853.notablePrerequisites: Cryptek does not have summoning sickness.
1913-3134-4050-4853.description:
Activate Cryptek by paying {1}{B} and tapping it, targeting Dross Scorpion.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {B}.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering itself and Cryptek.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cryptek.
Resolve the Cryptek trigger, returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {1}.
Repeat.

413-1303-1769.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it, Blasting Station and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the token Rot Hulk's trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

215-2026-2404-3464.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
215-2026-2404-3464.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Voyaging Satyr any number of times.
